India Post Office GDS Online Form 2026 (23757 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Department of Post (India Post) has released the notification for the post of Gramin Dak Sevaks GDS. This recruitment has been issued for 23757 posts. The online application process for India Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 has started on 31 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for India Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Registration Starting Date : 31 August 2026
  • Registration Last Date : 19 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Form Submission Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Pee Payment Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 23-24 September 2026
  • 1st Merit List : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
